views.markdown: AirDrop IPA Fix stops AirDrop from installing `.ipa` files automatically. Received IPAs are saved as regular files.

views.title: RootHide
views.text: Tested on iOS 16 (palera1n, RootHide) and iOS 18 (Dopamine 3, RootHide)

views.title: Rootless
views.text: Expected to work on iOS 16+ rootless jailbreaks

views.markdown:
### What it does

- Stops AirDrop from installing `.ipa` files automatically.
- Saves received IPAs as regular files.
- Leaves normal AirDrop for PDFs, photos, and other files unchanged.

### What it does not do

- No preference pane.
- No “Open With” picker.
- No changes to your download location.
- No changes to how IPAs are opened from Files or Safari.

### Install

1. Download the matching deb: RootHide (`iphoneos-arm64e`) or Rootless (`iphoneos-arm64`).
2. Install with Sileo, Zebra, or Filza.
3. Respring if `sharingd` does not reload automatically.

### Verification

SHA-256 checksums are published in `SHA256SUMS.txt` with the GitHub release.
